nuggets.text: The Gamecocks' opener was the hottest game on record at Williams-Brice: 95 degrees at kickoff, with the fourth quarter cut to 10 minutes.
The Gamecocks take the field to the 'Dawn' section of Also sprach Zarathustra, the famous 2001: A Space Odyssey music.
Behind Williams-Brice sit 22 immovable cabooses on an unused track, each a private party space called a Cockaboose.
When Sandstorm plays at Williams-Brice before kickoff and after touchdowns, the crowd can make the press box noticeably shake.
The east upper deck at Williams-Brice sways during games, inspiring coach Joe Morrison's line: 'If it ain't swayin', we ain't playin'.'
Shane Beamer, son of Frank Beamer, was a walk-on long snapper on Virginia Tech's 1999 national title game team.
Shane Beamer got a 4.5-gallon mayonnaise bath after winning the 2021 Duke's Mayo Bowl, and the video went viral.
Saturday is the first-ever meeting between the Gamecocks and the Towson Tigers.
The Gamecocks opened with a 57-0 rout of Kent State, piling up 645 yards with six different players scoring.
LaNorris Sellers is in his third season as the Gamecocks' starting quarterback, now working under his third offensive coordinator.
